_readme: Vetted public layers. The live build may only use these. Verified anonymously with CORS (Origin: https://chrislandvogt.github.io): NSW/national entries on 2026-11-17, Victorian ('vic-') entries on 2026-11-17. All feature entries are MapServer/FeatureServer sublayers usable as FeatureLayer; 'definitionExpression' (where present) must be applied; 'serviceMinScale' is the scale limit published by the service (override with layer.minScale if needed); 'notes' list caveats. 'hiddenFields' are never requested, shown or sent to the assistant (personal information). Items on staff/personal accounts or with terms restricting third-party/public use are excluded.

layers.title: Local Government Areas (ABS ASGS 2021)
layers.attribution: © Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS), ASGS Edition 3
layers.licence: CC BY 4.0
layers.notes: ABS approximation of gazetted LGAs (2021 edition). Full-resolution geometry is heavy (~0.5 MB per LGA); the service supports PBF + quantization so FeatureLayer is fine. Field names are lower case.

layers.title: Suburbs and Localities (ABS SAL 2021)
layers.attribution: © Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS), ASGS Edition 3
layers.licence: CC BY 4.0
layers.notes: 15k polygons nationally; filter with definitionExpression "state_name_2021 = 'New South Wales'" for NSW only.

layers.title: Statistical Areas Level 2 (ABS SA2 2021)
layers.attribution: © Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS), ASGS Edition 3
layers.licence: CC BY 4.0

layers.title: Population by LGA (ABS Regional Population 2025)
layers.attribution: © Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS), Regional Population 2024-25
layers.licence: Not stated in service metadata (ABS content is generally CC BY 4.0)
layers.notes: 2025 LGA boundaries with ERP for 2001-2025 (erp_2001..erp_2025) plus births, deaths and migration fields. Good for class-breaks on density or growth.

layers.title: Population by SA2 (ABS Regional Population 2025)
layers.attribution: © Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS), Regional Population 2024-25
layers.licence: Not stated in service metadata (ABS content is generally CC BY 4.0)
layers.notes: Service default displayField is state_name_2021; use sa2_name_2021 for titles.

layers.title: Socio-economic disadvantage by LGA (ABS SEIFA 2021)
layers.attribution: © Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS), SEIFA 2021
layers.licence: Not stated in service metadata (ABS content is generally CC BY 4.0)
layers.notes: IRSD decile 1 = most disadvantaged. Same geometry weight as abs-lga-2021.

layers.title: Land Zoning (NSW LEP)
layers.attribution: © State of New South Wales (Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure), NSW Planning Portal
layers.licence: Not stated in service metadata (NSW Government open data is generally CC BY 4.0 - confirm before reuse)
layers.notes: Service enforces minScale 100000. SYM_CODE holds the zone code (e.g. R2) - good for unique-value renderer.

layers.title: Heritage items and conservation areas (NSW LEP)
layers.attribution: © State of New South Wales (Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure), NSW Planning Portal
layers.licence: Not stated in service metadata (NSW Government open data is generally CC BY 4.0 - confirm before reuse)
layers.notes: Service enforces minScale 100000.

layers.title: Flood Planning Area (NSW LEP)
layers.coverage: NSW (councils with an LEP flood map)
layers.attribution: © State of New South Wales (Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure), NSW Planning Portal
layers.licence: Not stated in service metadata (NSW Government open data is generally CC BY 4.0 - confirm before reuse)
layers.notes: Only 629 polygons but very detailed (~1 MB for 5 features at full resolution). Service enforces minScale 50000. Not every council has an LEP flood map.

layers.title: Bush Fire Prone Land (NSW)
layers.attribution: © State of New South Wales (NSW Rural Fire Service / DPHI)
layers.licence: Not stated in service metadata (NSW Government open data is generally CC BY 4.0 - confirm before reuse)
layers.notes: Service default displayField (StartDate) is not a field in this layer; use d_Category. Values: Vegetation Category 1/2/3, Vegetation Buffer. Service enforces minScale 250000. One 502 Bad Gateway seen during testing (succeeded on retry).

layers.title: Development applications (NSW Planning Portal)
layers.attribution: © State of New South Wales (Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure), NSW Planning Portal
layers.licence: Not stated in service metadata (NSW Government open data is generally CC BY 4.0 - confirm before reuse)
layers.notes: STALE: latest LODGEMENT_DATE is April 2023 and latest DETERMINED_DATE Nov 2023, so present it as historical. Dates are text (e.g. 20201118). LGA_NAME is upper case (e.g. 'SUTHERLAND SHIRE'). Contains a DEVELOPMENT_SITE_OWNER field - do not show it. Layer JSON has no objectIdField key but OBJECTID is an OID-type field. Some points have bad coordinates (extent is skewed).

layers.title: Property lots (NSW Cadastre)
layers.attribution: © State of New South Wales (Spatial Services, Department of Customer Service)
layers.licence: Not stated in service metadata (NSW Government open data is generally CC BY 4.0 - confirm before reuse)
layers.notes: 3.36M polygons. Extent-based queries are fast (~0.1 s) but where=1=1 counts took 15 s, 62 s, 94 s and >120 s (timeout) across four tests and full-table queries time out - never run unfiltered statistics or a feature table on this layer. Server is 10.51: no PBF/quantization. Keep minScale <= 10000.

layers.title: Major roads (Digital Atlas of Australia)
layers.attribution: Digital Atlas of Australia; incorporates Geoscape Roads © Geoscape Australia
layers.licence: CC BY 4.0
layers.notes: hierarchy values: NATIONAL OR STATE HIGHWAY, ARTERIAL ROAD, SUB-ARTERIAL ROAD. Filter state = 'NSW' if needed.

layers.title: Railway stations (Geoscience Australia)
layers.attribution: © Commonwealth of Australia (Geoscience Australia)
layers.licence: CC BY 4.0

layers.title: Schools and preschools (NSW Points of Interest)
layers.attribution: © State of New South Wales (Spatial Services, Department of Customer Service)
layers.licence: Not stated in service metadata (NSW Government open data is generally CC BY 4.0 - confirm before reuse)
layers.definitionExpression: poitype IN ('Primary School','High School','Combined Primary-Secondary School','Combined Primary-High School','Special School','Preschool')
layers.notes: Uses the NSW POI layer filtered by definitionExpression. Service default minScale is 60000 - set layer.minScale = 0 explicitly to see all schools at state scale.

layers.title: Declared public hospitals
layers.attribution: © Commonwealth of Australia (Department of Health, Disability and Ageing; AIHW), via Digital Atlas of Australia
layers.licence: CC BY 4.0
layers.notes: Filter HSPTL_ST = 'NSW' for NSW only.

layers.title: Libraries (NSW Points of Interest)
layers.attribution: © State of New South Wales (Spatial Services, Department of Customer Service)
layers.licence: Not stated in service metadata (NSW Government open data is generally CC BY 4.0 - confirm before reuse)
layers.notes: Set layer.minScale = 0 to override the service default of 60000. Other useful poitype values: 'Community Facility', 'Swimming Pool Facility', 'Sports Centre', 'Child Care Centre', 'Police Station', 'Fire Station', 'Railway Station', 'Bus Interchange'.

layers.title: Parks (NSW Points of Interest)
layers.attribution: © State of New South Wales (Spatial Services, Department of Customer Service)
layers.licence: Not stated in service metadata (NSW Government open data is generally CC BY 4.0 - confirm before reuse)
layers.notes: Park points (not polygons). 'Sports Field' and 'Picnic Area' are other poitype values.

layers.title: Tree canopy cover 2022 (Greater Sydney, by mesh block)
layers.attribution: © State of New South Wales (DPHI / Environment and Heritage)
layers.licence: Not stated in service metadata (NSW Government open data is generally CC BY 4.0 - confirm before reuse)
layers.notes: 223k mesh-block polygons; service enforces minScale 100000. Canopy_Percentage suits a class-breaks renderer.

layers.title: Urban heat island 2016 (Greater Sydney)

popupFields.name: UHI_16_m
popupFields.label: Heat island effect (°C above non-urban reference)

layers.attribution: © State of New South Wales (DPHI), Urban Heat and Greening data (SEED)
layers.licence: Not stated in service metadata (NSW Government open data is generally CC BY 4.0 - confirm before reuse)
layers.notes: 68k mesh blocks. 10.81 server without PBF; queries ~1-3 s. CORS echoes the request origin rather than *.

layers.title: Heat vulnerability index 2022 (Greater Sydney, SA1)
layers.attribution: DPHI, RMIT (© State of New South Wales)
layers.licence: Not stated in service metadata (NSW Government open data is generally CC BY 4.0 - confirm before reuse)
layers.notes: Index values 1-5 (some null). CORS echoes the request origin rather than *.

layers.title: Major named rivers and streams (BoM Geofabric)
layers.attribution: © Commonwealth of Australia (Bureau of Meteorology) 2022, via Digital Atlas of Australia
layers.licence: CC BY 4.0
layers.notes: 350k segments; service enforces minScale ~202805.

layers.title: Near real-time bushfire extents
layers.attribution: © Commonwealth of Australia (Geoscience Australia), state fire agencies
layers.licence: CC BY 4.0
layers.notes: Live feed - feature count changes constantly and may be near zero for NSW on the day (14 NSW features at verification). Service enforces minScale ~589039 and maxScale ~624; set layer.minScale = 0 to see fires at state scale. Point layer /4 ('Location Points') also exists.

layers.title: Historical bushfire boundaries
layers.attribution: © Commonwealth of Australia (Geoscience Australia), state fire agencies
layers.licence: CC BY 4.0
layers.notes: 312k polygons; filter by state = 'NSW' and/or ignition_date for a cleaner map (e.g. Black Summer 2019-20).

layers.title: NSW aerial imagery (Spatial Services)
layers.attribution: © State of New South Wales (Spatial Services, Department of Customer Service)
layers.licence: Not stated in service metadata (NSW Government open data is generally CC BY 4.0 - confirm before reuse)
layers.notes: Cached Web Mercator tiles to level 23 (~1:70). Use as TileLayer in a custom Basemap; tile request verified (image/jpeg, CORS *).

layers.title: Local Government Areas (Vicmap Admin)
layers.attribution: © State of Victoria (Department of Transport and Planning), Vicmap
layers.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Vicmap item licence; excludes logos, branding and third-party content)
layers.notes: Current gazetted boundaries aligned to Vicmap Property (e.g. 'MERRI-BEK', not the ABS 2021 'Moreland'). 87 polygons = 79 councils + 8 unincorporated areas whose lga_name ends in '(UNINC)' - filter with "lga_name NOT LIKE '%(UNINC)'" for councils only. Names are upper case. Geometry is heavy (~150 KB per LGA at full resolution) but the service supports PBF/quantization.

layers.title: Suburbs and localities (Vicmap Admin)
layers.attribution: © State of Victoria (Department of Transport and Planning), Vicmap
layers.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Vicmap item licence; excludes logos, branding and third-party content)
layers.notes: Official gazetted localities (2,973). Names are upper case.

layers.title: Planning scheme zones (Vicmap Planning)
layers.attribution: © State of Victoria (Department of Transport and Planning), Vicmap
layers.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Vicmap item licence; excludes logos, branding and third-party content)
layers.notes: 51k polygons. zone_code holds codes such as GRZ1, NRZ1, C1Z, IN1Z - group by prefix for a unique-value renderer. Metadata displayField is upper case (SCHEME_CODE) but real field names are lower case.

layers.title: Flood overlays: LSIO, FO, SBO (Vicmap Planning)
layers.attribution: © State of Victoria (Department of Transport and Planning), Vicmap
layers.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Vicmap item licence; excludes logos, branding and third-party content)
layers.definitionExpression: zone_code LIKE 'LSIO%' OR zone_code LIKE 'FO%' OR zone_code LIKE 'SBO%'
layers.notes: Land Subject to Inundation Overlay, Floodway Overlay and Special Building Overlay from the shared overlay layer. Overlay polygons are detailed (~125 KB each at full resolution); keep a scale limit.

layers.title: Bushfire Management Overlay (Vicmap Planning)
layers.attribution: © State of Victoria (Department of Transport and Planning), Vicmap
layers.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Vicmap item licence; excludes logos, branding and third-party content)

layers.title: Heritage Overlay (Vicmap Planning)
layers.attribution: © State of Victoria (Department of Transport and Planning), Vicmap
layers.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Vicmap item licence; excludes logos, branding and third-party content)
layers.notes: zone_code is the schedule number (e.g. HO30) - the heritage place name is in the planning scheme schedule, not in this layer.

layers.title: Bushfire Prone Areas (Vicmap Planning)
layers.attribution: © State of Victoria (Department of Transport and Planning), Vicmap
layers.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Vicmap item licence; excludes logos, branding and third-party content)
layers.notes: Only 76 features but each is one huge multipart polygon (~450 KB at full resolution; 5 features took 1.7 s). Fine with PBF/quantization at state scale, but avoid outFields=* full-geometry queries.

layers.title: Land parcels (Vicmap Property)
layers.attribution: © State of Victoria (Department of Transport and Planning), Vicmap
layers.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Vicmap item licence; excludes logos, branding and third-party content)
layers.notes: About 4.3M parcels. Hosted with PBF, so extent queries and even full counts are fast, but keep minScale <= 10000. No owner or valuation fields in this layer.

layers.title: Public transport stops: train, tram, bus (DTP)
layers.attribution: © State of Victoria (Department of Transport and Planning), DTP Open Data Platform
layers.licence: Not stated in item metadata (DTP Open Data Platform; Victorian Government open data is generally CC BY 4.0 - confirm before reuse)
layers.notes: 32k stops. MODE values: METRO BUS, METRO TRAM, METRO TRAIN, REGIONAL BUS, REGIONAL TRAIN, REGIONAL COACH, SKYBUS, INTERSTATE TRAIN - filter e.g. "MODE = 'METRO TRAIN'" (2,868) for stations at state scale.

layers.title: Public transport routes: train, tram, bus (DTP)
layers.attribution: © State of Victoria (Department of Transport and Planning), DTP Open Data Platform
layers.licence: Not stated in item metadata (DTP Open Data Platform; Victorian Government open data is generally CC BY 4.0 - confirm before reuse)
layers.notes: HEAVY: 15,660 GTFS shapes (one per route variant and direction, so lines overlap); 5 features = ~240 KB at full resolution. Always filter by MODE (same values as vic-pt-stops), e.g. "MODE = 'METRO TRAM'".

layers.title: Road crashes 2012-2026 (DTP)
layers.attribution: © State of Victoria (Department of Transport and Planning), DTP Open Data Platform (Victoria Police and hospital data)
layers.licence: Not stated in item metadata (DTP Open Data Platform; Victorian Government open data is generally CC BY 4.0 - confirm before reuse)
layers.notes: 202k crash points from Jan 2012 to Feb 2026 (monthly updates with ~7-month lag; recent fatal crashes provisional). SEVERITY values: Fatal accident, Serious injury accident, Other injury accident. ACCIDENT_DATE is a DateOnly field; filter with the integer ACCIDENT_DATE_INT instead (e.g. ACCIDENT_DATE_INT >= 20240101). No personal identifiers; person fields are counts only.

layers.title: Traffic volumes (AADT 2019, DTP)
layers.attribution: © State of Victoria (Department of Transport and Planning), DTP Open Data Platform
layers.licence: Not stated in item metadata (DTP Open Data Platform; Victorian Government open data is generally CC BY 4.0 - confirm before reuse)
layers.notes: 2019 (pre-COVID) annual average daily traffic by road segment and direction; arterial roads only. Good for a graduated-width line renderer.

layers.title: Schools (Vicmap Features of Interest)
layers.attribution: © State of Victoria (Department of Transport and Planning), Vicmap
layers.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Vicmap item licence; excludes logos, branding and third-party content)
layers.definitionExpression: feature_type = 'education centre' AND feature_subtype IN ('primary school','secondary school','primary/secondary school','special school')
layers.notes: Government and non-government schools (no sector field). Other education subtypes: 'tertiary institution', 'university', 'further education'.

layers.title: Hospitals (Vicmap Features of Interest)
layers.attribution: © State of Victoria (Department of Transport and Planning), Vicmap
layers.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Vicmap item licence; excludes logos, branding and third-party content)
layers.notes: feature_subtype: general hospital, day procedure centre, bush nursing hospital. Public and private. feature_type 'health facility' holds other health services.

layers.title: Libraries (Vicmap Features of Interest)
layers.attribution: © State of Victoria (Department of Transport and Planning), Vicmap
layers.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Vicmap item licence; excludes logos, branding and third-party content)
layers.notes: Other useful FOI point filters: feature_type 'community venue' (hall, community centre, senior citizens, neighbourhood house), 'emergency facility' (fire/police/ambulance stations, 'neighbourhood safer place'), 'sport facility'.

layers.title: Parks and reserves (Vicmap Features of Interest)
layers.attribution: © State of Victoria (Department of Transport and Planning), Vicmap
layers.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Vicmap item licence; excludes logos, branding and third-party content)
layers.definitionExpression: feature_type = 'reserve' AND feature_subtype IN ('park','gardens','conservation park','national park')
layers.notes: Polygons (not points). Mostly 'park' (27k). Parks Victoria's own estate layer was not found on a public ArcGIS REST endpoint.

layers.title: Urban heat and vegetation cover 2018 by suburb (Melbourne)
layers.attribution: © State of Victoria (DTP / DEECA), Cooling and Greening Melbourne
layers.licence: Not stated in service metadata (Victorian Government open data is generally CC BY 4.0 - confirm before reuse)
layers.notes: 442 suburbs. Mesh-block version (54k polygons) at .../CoolingGreening/MapServer/55; 2014 equivalents also in the service. 10.81 server: no PBF; CORS echoes the request origin.

layers.title: Heat vulnerability index 2018 by suburb (Melbourne)
layers.attribution: © State of Victoria (DTP / DEECA), Cooling and Greening Melbourne
layers.licence: Not stated in service metadata (Victorian Government open data is generally CC BY 4.0 - confirm before reuse)
layers.notes: 428 suburbs; HVI_2018 ranges 0-5 (higher = more vulnerable). No PBF; CORS echoes origin.

layers.title: Tree cover 2018 by mesh block (Melbourne)
layers.attribution: © State of Victoria (DTP / DEECA), Cooling and Greening Melbourne
layers.licence: Not stated in service metadata (Victorian Government open data is generally CC BY 4.0 - confirm before reuse)
layers.notes: 54k mesh blocks; 10.81 server without PBF - keep the scale limit. LGA names are 2016 (e.g. Moreland).

layers.title: Rivers and creeks - major and medium (Vicmap Hydro)
layers.attribution: © State of Victoria (Department of Transport and Planning), Vicmap
layers.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Vicmap item licence; excludes logos, branding and third-party content)
layers.notes: The full watercourse network has 1.83M segments; this filter keeps hierarchy H and M (~114k). Drop the filter only below 1:25,000.

layers.title: Fire history - bushfires 1903-2025 (DEECA)
layers.attribution: © State of Victoria (DEECA Forest Fire Management Victoria; CFA)
layers.licence: Not stated in service metadata (Victorian Government open data is generally CC BY 4.0 - confirm before reuse)
layers.notes: 628k bushfire polygons (716k incl. planned burns: FIRETYPE 'Burn'). SEASON ranges 1903-2025. 10.81 server, no PBF; ~0.5 s per query. Filter by SEASON (e.g. SEASON = 2009 for Black Saturday) for a cleaner map. METHOD_COMMENTS is free text and is hidden as a precaution.

layers.title: Current bushfire incidents (DEECA / CFA, live)
layers.attribution: © State of Victoria (DEECA Forest Fire Management Victoria; CFA)
layers.licence: Not stated in service metadata (Victorian Government open data is generally CC BY 4.0 - confirm before reuse)
layers.notes: LIVE feed on DEECA's eMap server - count changes constantly (4 incidents at verification) and may be empty on the day. Not an official public API; stability unknown, so have a fallback (vic-fire-history). Sibling layers: /1 CFA other incidents, /2 SES incidents, /3 FRV incidents. Not a warnings feed - VicEmergency remains the authoritative source.

excluded.title: NSW Spatial Services Features of Interest / portal services
excluded.reason: Service directory did not respond within 60-90 s from the test machine (two attempts). Not usable on stage.

excluded.title: NSW Spatial Services LGA boundaries
excluded.reason: Works anonymously with CORS *, but the 10.51 server has no PBF/quantization, so a FeatureLayer pulls full-resolution geometry (~2.3 MB for 5 LGAs). Use abs-lga-2021 instead (or load this as a MapImageLayer sublayer).

excluded.title: NSW Spatial Services suburbs
excluded.reason: Works (CORS *, 4,607 features, has postcode) but omitted as a duplicate of abs-suburbs-2021; no PBF support.

excluded.title: DA tracking (duplicate service)
excluded.reason: Works (CORS *) but duplicates nsw-development-applications with the same 2023-dated data.

excluded.title: Greater Sydney canopy cover 2024 (raster)
excluded.reason: Works as a map-image export (CORS echoes origin) but is a raster with no attributes or popups; omitted in favour of sydney-tree-canopy-2022.

excluded.title: Roadworks and road closures (RADAR, national)
excluded.reason: Works (CORS echoes origin, 342k records) but mixes historical and current records with inconsistent status values by state. If needed, use definitionExpression "state = 'NSW' AND status = 'Open'" (~10k). Omitted to keep the catalogue at 25-ish solid entries.

excluded.title: Bus stops (NSW)
excluded.reason: No public ArcGIS REST bus stop layer for NSW found in ArcGIS Online searches or on NSW Government servers. Only regional bus routes are included.

excluded.title: Traffic counts / volumes (NSW)
excluded.reason: Only third-party copies found (consultancy account), not an authoritative TfNSW ArcGIS REST source. Not verified or included.

excluded.title: Urban heat island copies on university accounts
excluded.reason: Student/research copies of SEED data; authoritative NSW DPHI services are used instead.

excluded.title: City of Sydney EV charging bays
excluded.reason: Works (CORS *), but only 59 council-operated bays in one LGA; the NSW-wide EV layers are more useful.

excluded.title: Regional NSW bus routes (TfNSW GTFS)
excluded.reason: Transport for NSW staff account; item terms say not intended for third-party use. Left out by decision on 17 Nov 2026.

excluded.title: EV fast charging stations (above 50 kW, NSW)
excluded.reason: Transport for NSW staff account; item terms say not intended for third-party use. Left out by decision on 17 Nov 2026.

excluded.title: VicRoads Maps org layers (regional bus/train/coach stops and routes, Traffic_Volume, VIC_Flood_Overlay, Bicycle_infrastructure, etc.)
excluded.reason: Work anonymously, but the items checked (Regional_Bus_Stops, Traffic_Volume) are owned by a named staff account (tayebeh.saghapour_vicroadsmaps) with no licence stated. Excluded under the staff/personal-account rule; DTP's networkdata_victransport equivalents are used instead.

excluded.title: Victorian road crash data copies on personal/student/consultancy accounts
excluded.reason: Copies owned by university, student and consultancy accounts (e.g. s4250047_UQmaps, jason.thompson_UOM, dradiceski_servicestream, darkoradiceski_lendlease). The official DTP layer (vic-road-crashes) is used.

excluded.title: Metro bus stops on an Esri Australia staff account (bus_stops_metro)
excluded.reason: Staff account (kmorrish_esriau). Not verified; vic-pt-stops covers metro bus stops.

excluded.title: Vicmap-derived copies on university accounts (planning zones, crown land tenure)
excluded.reason: Student copies (llia0029_monashuniversity). The official Vicmap_Prod services are used.

excluded.title: Native vegetation / Ecological Vegetation Classes (NV2005, 1750 EVC)
excluded.reason: No official DEECA ArcGIS REST service found anonymously. Only copies exist (Goulburn Broken CMA tile copy; personal accounts Shani.Blyth and MSCESRI). Not verified or included - gap.

excluded.title: Victoria fire history copy (Brimbank City Council)
excluded.reason: Council copy of DEECA data; the DEECA source (vic-fire-history) is used.

excluded.title: VicPlan fire history (plan-gis)
excluded.reason: Metadata and CORS fine, but where=1=1 returned a count of 0 - the layer appears empty or filtered. vic-fire-history (DEECA eMap) is used instead.

excluded.title: MapShareVic enterprise folders (VicPlan, Vicmap, features, Demography)
excluded.reason: Folders return 'Token Required' (error 499). Not usable anonymously.

excluded.title: Department of Education school locations
excluded.reason: No Department of Education ArcGIS REST service found in ArcGIS Online searches. Schools come from Vicmap Features of Interest (no government/non-government sector field).

excluded.title: VicEmergency warnings / incident feed
excluded.reason: No VicEmergency/EMV ArcGIS REST service found. The DEECA eMap incidents layer (vic-incidents-live) is the only live ArcGIS REST source found.

excluded.title: Vicmap Vegetation Tree Urban (individual urban trees)
excluded.reason: Works (CORS *, PBF) but holds 11.3M tree points; only usable below about 1:5,000. Omitted; vic-tree-cover-2018-meshblock gives a better overview.

excluded.title: Vicmap Property (property polygons)
excluded.reason: Works (CORS *, 1.78M polygons) but duplicates vic-parcels for a demo; no owner fields.

excluded.title: Vicmap Transport road network
excluded.reason: Metadata and CORS fine (PBF), but very wide schema and dense; omitted in favour of national-major-roads plus vic-traffic-volume. Usable with class_code filters and minScale <= 50000 if needed.

excluded.title: City of Melbourne urban heat and tree canopy
excluded.reason: Official City of Melbourne account, but covers one LGA only; not verified. The metro-wide Cooling and Greening Melbourne layers are used.
